title: Colour
slide_intent: Teach designers to link a venue’s identifying color to the correct name so a color cue can help distinguish one site from another.
strategic_value: Sheffield Museums can give six venues individual color cues and still support a shared institutional palette.
demonstration: Six color fields pair venue names with their hero colors. Adjacent rows list venue-specific and shared choices. The note cautions against borrowing a different venue’s hero color.
practical_value: Start with white, black or the promoted venue’s hero color. Check the venue mapping before using a hero color on a communication.

content_islands.name: Color guidance
content_islands.spec: Place the title and hero-color guidance in a narrow column at left.

content_islands.name: Venue palette key
content_islands.spec: Under the guidance, label each site and display its hero swatch alongside shared choices.

content_islands.name: Hero-color specimens
content_islands.spec: Build a contiguous two-by-three grid at right. Center one venue mark in each field and switch between light and dark lettering for contrast.

reference_purposes.Expression: Six venue marks appear on their corresponding hero-color fields.
reference_purposes.Application: The swatch key pairs each venue’s hero color with the shared supporting choices.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The text says to avoid another venue’s hero color when promoting a particular venue.

ingredient.name: Venue hero color
ingredient.role: Associate each venue name with a recurring color cue.
ingredient.application: For venue logos, start with white, black or the venue’s own hero color. Shared palette colors may also be used when appropriate. Avoid using a different venue’s hero color for the promoted venue.
ingredient.scope: Venue logos and venue-specific communications. The palette key maps six venues; the parent museum’s access to all colors is described separately.
